title: READABLE HIT REACTIONS SHOWCASE
description: The feature rebuilds routine play around the moment a player considers leaving. Enemies now stagger, flash, and fall with timing that makes successful hits feel less like clerical work. Boss intros and failure states now create cleaner moments for streams, trailers, and context-free yelling.
consequence: The combat log finally stopped doing all the emotional labor. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.

title: READABLE HIT REACTIONS FOUNDATION
description: The release frames the feature as seasonal structure, while burying the real priority in the reward cadence. Enemies now stagger, flash, and fall with timing that makes successful hits feel less like clerical work. Several improvements focus on crash fixes, save safety, and boring reliability instead of visible beats.
consequence: The combat log finally stopped doing all the emotional labor. The game improved in ways that make terrible thumbnails.

title: GROUNDED TRAVERSAL PASS SHOWCASE
description: The change decides which delays are atmosphere and which delays are invoices. Jumping, mounting, and rolling now preserve more momentum debt so movement feels heavier and more authored.
